    }

    int digits[70], count_digits = 0;
    while (N) {
        digits[count_digits++] = N % K;
        N /= K;
    }

    static Matrix A[64][30], prefixSum[64][30], suffix[64][30], result;
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
            A[0][i].mat[j][j] = 1;
            A[0][i].mat[j][i] = 1;
        }

    }

    prefixSum[0][0] = A[0][0];

    for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i)
        prefixSum[0][i] = prefixSum[0][i - 1] * A[0][i];

    for (int i = K - 2; i >= 0; --i)
        suffix[0][i] = A[0][i] * suffix[0][i + 1];

    for (int i = 1; i < count_digits; ++i) {

        prefixSum[i][0] = A[i][0];
        suffix[i][K - 1] = A[i][K - 1];

        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
            prefixSum[i][j] = prefixSum[i][j - 1] * A[i][j];

        for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; --j)
            suffix[i][j] = A[i][j] * suffix[i][j + 1];
    }

    result.mat[0][K] = 1;
    result.size = K;
